lines.zh: 我没有脚踩地，可我仍在走。
lines.en: I have no feet to press down, yet I walk.

lines.zh: 腐化的边缘落下来，像灰。
lines.en: Corrupted edges flake off me like ash.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草叶会弯向反方向。
lines.en: Where I pass, grass leans the wrong way.

lines.zh: 我踩着旧日的路，路已经没了。
lines.en: I tread an old road that no longer exists.

lines.zh: 铠甲声还在，只是铠早烂了。
lines.en: The armor still clanks; the armor rotted long ago.

lines.zh: 我走得很直，像还记得队形。
lines.en: I walk dead straight, as if I remember a formation.

lines.zh: 风穿过去，我散了一半又合上。
lines.en: Wind passes through; I scatter half and re-form.

lines.zh: 我在找一面早就不在的旗。
lines.en: I am looking for a banner long gone.

lines.zh: 每一步都比上一步淡一点。
lines.en: Each step is fainter than the last.

lines.zh: 我跟在自己后面，走不完。
lines.en: I follow behind myself and never arrive.

lines.zh: 影子不跟着我，它先走了。
lines.en: My shadow does not follow; it left first.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过，在变成这样之前。
lines.en: I have walked this road before I became this.

lines.zh: 我记得自己曾有个名字。
lines.en: I remember once having a name.

lines.zh: 现在只有腐化的声音在响。
lines.en: Now only the sound of corruption remains.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一尊忘了收的碑。
lines.en: I stand like a monument no one put away.

lines.zh: 光穿过我，落在地上是脏的。
lines.en: Light passes through me and lands soiled.

lines.zh: 我试着握拳，手已经不听。
lines.en: I try to make a fist; my hand no longer obeys.

lines.zh: 有些片段反复亮：一个人，一面墙。
lines.en: Fragments keep flaring: a person, a wall.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，却总在喘。
lines.en: I need no breath, yet I keep gasping.

lines.zh: 腐化在啃记忆，从最早的那块。
lines.en: Corruption eats my memory, starting with the earliest.

lines.zh: 周围太静，我就自己低声数。
lines.en: It is too quiet, so I count under my breath.

lines.zh: 我等的援军不会来了。
lines.en: The reinforcements I wait for will not come.

lines.zh: 这副残影是我仅剩的。
lines.en: This tattered remnant is all I have left.

lines.zh: 我听见有人在喊，声音像我。
lines.en: I hear someone shouting, and the voice is mine.

lines.zh: 尸壳走过，我们不打招呼。
lines.en: A husk passes; we do not greet each other.

lines.zh: 我把碎片拼回人形，又散了。
lines.en: I piece myself back into a person, then fall apart.

lines.zh: 我试着立正，腿已经不听口令。
lines.en: I try to stand at attention. My legs no longer take orders.

lines.zh: 我把名字念了一遍，没人接。
lines.en: I say my name once. Nothing answers.

lines.zh: 你活着，我一眼就看出来了。
lines.en: You are alive; I can tell at a glance.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲是新的，我的不是。
lines.en: Your armor is new. Mine is not.

lines.zh: 你身上有誓言的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of an oath.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为你还站得直。
lines.en: I stare because you still stand straight.

lines.zh: 你走路的姿势，像我从前。
lines.en: The way you walk is how I once walked.

lines.zh: 别看我的脸，那里什么也没剩。
lines.en: Do not look at my face; nothing is left there.

lines.zh: 你手里的剑，握法不对。
lines.en: You are holding that sword wrong.

lines.zh: 我想提醒你，可我的声音是坏的。
lines.en: I want to warn you, but my voice is broken.

lines.zh: 你还记得谁吗？我记不全了。
lines.en: Do you remember anyone? I no longer can.

lines.zh: 你的心跳太响，吵得我疼。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is loud enough to hurt me.

lines.zh: 你在害怕，这很正常。
lines.en: You are afraid; that is entirely reasonable.

lines.zh: 我看了很久，才想起那是眼睛。
lines.en: I look a long time before recalling those are eyes.

lines.zh: 你若转身走，我不会追。
lines.en: If you turn and leave, I will not chase.

lines.zh: 你身上有个影子，比我完整。
lines.en: You carry a shadow more whole than mine.

lines.zh: 这一下打散了半边肩。
lines.en: That blow scattered half my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一刀穿过我，我只少了一角。
lines.en: The blade passes through. I only lose a corner.

lines.zh: 疼比记忆来得清楚。
lines.en: The pain is clearer than the memory.

lines.zh: 我又散开一次，慢慢聚回来。
lines.en: I come apart again, then slowly gather back.

lines.zh: 腐化替我咬着伤口。
lines.en: The corruption bites the wound shut for me.

lines.zh: 你的剑带走了我半张脸。
lines.en: Your sword takes half my face with it.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，甲片掉在地上。
lines.en: I step back; a plate of armor falls to the ground.

lines.zh: 散开的碎片在找回来的路。
lines.en: The scattered pieces are finding their way back.

lines.zh: 我不流血，只漏出一点灰。
lines.en: I don't bleed. Only a little ash leaks out.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起自己怎么死的。
lines.en: That blow reminds me how I died.

lines.zh: 我早就不饿了，可我还是凑过去。
lines.en: I stopped being hungry long ago, yet I drift closer.

lines.zh: 你举着那块铁，我的旧习醒了。
lines.en: You raise that iron and my old habit wakes.

lines.zh: 那东西亮，像从前火把的光。
lines.en: It shines like torchlight from before.

lines.zh: 我闻到了铁锈，闻到队伍的味道。
lines.en: I smell rust, and the smell of a company.

lines.zh: 别晃太快，我的眼睛跟不上。
lines.en: Do not wave it so fast; my eyes lag behind.

lines.zh: 我伸手，是想握住，不是要抢。
lines.en: I reach out to hold it, not to take it.

lines.zh: 有东西能让我记起来一会儿。
lines.en: Something here lets me remember for a while.

lines.zh: 我跟着那点光，走了很远。
lines.en: I follow that small light a long way.

lines.zh: 你放下它，我也不会捡。
lines.en: If you set it down, I still will not pick it up.

lines.zh: 这不算饿，只是舍不得走。
lines.en: It is not hunger; I simply cannot bear to leave.

lines.zh: 我连影子都算不上。
lines.en: I am not even a shadow.

lines.zh: 我撞不到实物，只撞到活气。
lines.en: I hit nothing solid, only living warmth.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我会沾上你。
lines.en: Do not press so close; I will stain you.

lines.zh: 相撞时，我的碎片落进你衣领。
lines.en: On impact, my flakes fall into your collar.

lines.zh: 我退开，是怕腐化传过去。
lines.en: I pull back lest the corruption pass to you.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞散了一角。
lines.en: That knock scattered one corner of me.

lines.zh: 我半透明的身体穿过你，又凝回来。
lines.en: My translucent body passes through you and thickens again.

lines.zh: 我们碰在一起，风都停了。
lines.en: We meet and even the wind stops.

lines.zh: 你踩过我的位置，我让开了。
lines.en: You stepped through my spot; I yielded it.

lines.zh: 碰撞不疼，只是又少了点。
lines.en: Colliding does not hurt; I only lose a little more.

lines.zh: 两个魂靠近，会互相啃。
lines.en: Two souls close together gnaw at each other.

lines.zh: 我记不起有没有人等过我。
lines.en: I cannot recall whether anyone waited for me.

lines.zh: 腐化的东西不该有后代。
lines.en: Corrupted things should not have offspring.

lines.zh: 若还有另一个我，它也会散。
lines.en: If another of me exists, it too will scatter.

lines.zh: 我伸手，只是想要个回应。
lines.en: I reach out only to be answered.

lines.zh: 这一点点暖，我留不住。
lines.en: This little warmth I cannot keep.

lines.zh: 靠近了才看清，它也是残的。
lines.en: Only up close do I see it is also broken.

lines.zh: 我们不靠近，站着已经够了。
lines.en: We keep apart; standing near is enough.

lines.zh: 谁都没有名字了，怎么称呼。
lines.en: Neither of us has a name left to call.

lines.zh: 下次再见，可能认不出来。
lines.en: Next time we meet, we may not recognize each other.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我连手都留不住。
lines.en: I pick up nothing; I cannot even keep my hands.

lines.zh: 地上的剑我看了一眼，走了。
lines.en: I glance at the sword on the ground and move on.

lines.zh: 我抓不住，东西会穿过我。
lines.en: I cannot grasp; things pass through me.

lines.zh: 有人给我留过东西，我没拿。
lines.en: Someone once left me something; I did not take it.

lines.zh: 带着物件，只会更沉。
lines.en: Carrying things would only weigh me down.

lines.zh: 掉落不是我的，我没有掉落表。
lines.en: Drops are not mine; I have no loot table.

lines.zh: 我把头盔放在石头上，没带走。
lines.en: I set the helmet on a stone and left it.

lines.zh: 弯不下腰，我不试了。
lines.en: I cannot bend down, so I stop trying.

lines.zh: 东西在你手里更好。
lines.en: That thing is better off in your hands.

lines.zh: 别塞给我，会掉下去。
lines.en: Do not press it on me; it will fall through.

lines.zh: 你的活气太亮，我躲不开。
lines.en: Your living warmth is too bright to ignore.

lines.zh: 腐化在我耳边说：那边。
lines.en: The corruption whispers at my ear: that one.

lines.zh: 我认得这个距离，冲锋前就是这样。
lines.en: I know this distance; it is how a charge begins.

lines.zh: 脚下的影子先转向你。
lines.en: My shadow on the ground turns to you first.

lines.zh: 你走近了三步，够了。
lines.en: You came three steps closer. That is enough.

lines.zh: 我记得该怎么打，身体还记得。
lines.en: I remember how to fight; my body remembers.

lines.zh: 你身上那股劲，让我想起敌人。
lines.en: That force in you reminds me of an enemy.

lines.zh: 我不是在挑你，是没别的可选。
lines.en: I am not choosing you; there is nothing else.

lines.zh: 我记得握剑的手势，碎片照着摆好。
lines.en: I remember how to grip a sword; my fragments fall into place.

lines.zh: 我的碎片开始朝一个方向聚。
lines.en: My fragments begin gathering in one direction.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声叹息，是开始的信号。
lines.en: That sigh you heard was the signal to begin.

lines.zh: 别怪腐化，它只是先开了口。
lines.en: Do not blame the corruption; it only spoke first.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的胸口，那里最热。
lines.en: I fix on your chest, where the heat is strongest.

lines.zh: 这一步迈出去，就回不了头。
lines.en: Once I take this step, there is no turning back.

lines.zh: 我贴地飘，速度不快，但不停。
lines.en: I skim low, not fast, but never stopping.

lines.zh: 你拐弯，我早就在那边。
lines.en: You turn a corner; I am already there.

lines.zh: 腐化拖在我后面，像一条尾巴。
lines.en: The corruption trails behind me like a tail.

lines.zh: 你越跑，我越清楚你在哪。
lines.en: The more you run, the clearer your position.

lines.zh: 我不用绕路，墙挡不住魂。
lines.en: I need no detour; walls do not stop a soul.

lines.zh: 记得回头看，我不出声。
lines.en: Remember to look back; I make no sound.

lines.zh: 你的火把在灭，我的路更清楚。
lines.en: Your torch is dying, and my path grows clear.

lines.zh: 我在数你还有几步能跑。
lines.en: I am counting how many steps you have left.

lines.zh: 别躲进洞里，那里更窄。
lines.en: Do not hide in a cave; it is narrower there.

lines.zh: 腐化喜欢恐惧的味道。
lines.en: The corruption savors the taste of fear.

lines.zh: 我经过的草都枯了，你能看见。
lines.en: The grass withers where I pass; you can see it.

lines.zh: 你停下来了，这说明你懂了。
lines.en: You have stopped. That means you understand.

lines.zh: 我不急，我已经等了很久。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; I have waited long.

lines.zh: 前面没有援军，我知道。
lines.en: There are no reinforcements ahead. I know.

lines.zh: 你朝那座门跑，我早就在门口。
lines.en: You run for that gate. I'm already at it.

lines.zh: 我的手穿进去，带出一片冷。
lines.en: My hand passes in and draws out a cold.

lines.zh: 这一击用的是旧招式，还没忘。
lines.en: This blow is an old form I have not forgotten.

lines.zh: 腐化顺着伤口往里走。
lines.en: The corruption follows the wound inward.

lines.zh: 我打中的时候，自己也碎了一块。
lines.en: When I land the hit, a piece of me breaks off.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，力度正好。
lines.en: You fall back two steps; the force was right.

lines.zh: 别用盾，魂会从边上绕。
lines.en: Skip the shield; a soul slips around its edge.

lines.zh: 我记得收招，可手停不下来。
lines.en: I remember the recovery, but my hand will not stop.

lines.zh: 我的指甲早就没了，剩下的更利。
lines.en: My nails are long gone; what remains cuts deeper.

lines.zh: 你身上的光暗了一下。
lines.en: The light on you dimmed for a moment.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我又淡了一层。
lines.en: After this blow I fade another layer.

lines.zh: 我从刷怪蛋里被拽出来，没有别的路。
lines.en: I am pulled out of a spawn egg; there is no other way.

lines.zh: 这个世界没给我留生成的地方。
lines.en: This world left no place for me to spawn.

lines.zh: 我不属于任何群系，风也不认我。
lines.en: I belong to no biome; even the wind disowns me.

lines.zh: 睁眼时四周是方块，没有人。
lines.en: I open my eyes to blocks and no one else.

lines.zh: 我是被人放下的，不是长出来的。
lines.en: I was set down by a hand, not grown.

lines.zh: 没有巢，没有队伍，只有我。
lines.en: No nest, no company, only me.

lines.zh: 我一出现，附近的火把就暗了。
lines.en: The moment I appear, nearby torches dim.

lines.zh: 腐化比我先到，在我成形之前。
lines.en: The corruption arrived before me, before I took shape.

lines.zh: 我记得上一世的最后一句话。
lines.en: I remember the last words of my previous life.

lines.zh: 别问我从哪来，蛋不会回答。
lines.en: Do not ask where I came from; an egg does not answer.

lines.zh: 我落地时没有声音，只有冷。
lines.en: I land without a sound, only a cold.

lines.zh: 这具残影是新的，记忆是旧的。
lines.en: This remnant is new; the memories are old.

lines.zh: 有人捏碎蛋壳，我就站在这里。
lines.en: Someone crushed the shell, and here I stand.

lines.zh: 我没有掉落，杀了也留不下什么。
lines.en: I have no drops; killing me leaves nothing behind.

lines.zh: 火能烧到魂，真稀奇。
lines.en: Fire can burn a soul. Curious.

lines.zh: 我落下去，碎成了几片。
lines.en: I fall and break into several pieces.

lines.zh: 水压着我，我连散都散不开。
lines.en: Water presses me; I cannot even scatter.

lines.zh: 我本是英雄的魂，如今只剩烟。
lines.en: I was a hero's soul. Now only smoke.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，带走了点东西。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and takes something with it.

lines.zh: 咒法打过来，比刀更疼。
lines.en: Their magic hurts more than any blade.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我还是空。
lines.en: I eat nothing, yet I am still empty.

lines.zh: 雷光里，我看见了自己的轮廓。
lines.en: In the lightning I see my own outline.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有回声，我喊不出。
lines.en: The void has no echo; I cannot call out.
